name: SMART Tunnel
area: Kampung Berembang to Sungai Besi, Kuala Lumpur (corridor)
status_detail: Operational · stormwater diversion and motorway tunnel
summary: The 9.7 km Stormwater Management and Road Tunnel, a dual-purpose motorway and stormwater diversion tunnel protecting central Kuala Lumpur from Klang River flooding. Reported to have diverted floodwaters 55 times and averted about RM4.5 billion in damage.

scale.label: Reported record
scale.value: 55 flood diversions; about RM4.5 billion in averted damage

why_it_matters: The template for KL's flood politics. Every monsoon, its activations and any overflow downstream shape the debate about new flood mitigation spending across the valley.
questions_to_follow: How many storm modes are activated in the current monsoon season?
What stage are the broader Klang River flood mitigation plans at?
